title: AsyncAPI v2.5.0 - Channel Operation Message Trait
description: Describes a trait that MAY be applied to an Channel Operation Message

schemaFormat.description: A string containing the name of the schema format/language used to define the message payload.

contentType.description: The content type to use when encoding/decoding a message's payload.

headers.description: Schema definition of the application headers.

messageId.description: Unique string used to identify the message. The id MUST be unique among all messages described in the API.

correlationId.description: Definition of the correlation ID used for message tracing or matching.

tags.description: A list of tags for logical grouping and categorization of messages.

summary.description: A brief summary of the message.

title.description: A human-friendly title for the message.

description.description: A longer description of the message. CommonMark is allowed.
